programs.name: robust_regime_trend
programs.description: Use when the latest low-jump segment is smoothly decreasing; changepoint isolation and robust local increments avoid the parent's unstable power/window selection across pulse and crash regimes.
programs.assumption: During the next 100 steps, the median one-step decrement remains between 0.04 and 0.12, local acceleration has magnitude below 0.0005 per step squared, and no single jump exceeds 0.5.
programs.failure_condition: It fails if a new pulse or crash changes the level by more than 0.5, the tail reverses direction, or curvature exceeds 0.0005 per step squared for a sustained interval.
